kwargs.content: {"summary":"From about 15:41 UTC on 2026-03-17, checkout p99 latency rose roughly 5x (about 330 ms to about 1600 ms) and error rate rose from 0.4% to about 9%. The fraud-check dependency degraded at the same time, with p99 near 2400 ms and about 31% of calls timing out at the 2000 ms limit, so orders were held as unverifiable.
